name: Rhino Whisky
note: Small South African single-malt Scotch brand (contract-distilled in Speyside, Scotland; rwhisky.com) founded by Gerrit Wagener and Brin Kushner, per 2022 press coverage (aspirelifestyle.co.za; whiskyoftheweek.co.uk spells the second name 'Kuchner'). No company register extract or outside investor was found; ownership beyond the founders is undocumented.
